texts.zh:
[dreadnought_system.GetName]恒星系发现一艘形单影只的巨型战舰在巡航。船只上未发现有机生命迹象，但发出强烈能量特征，可能是装备有武器系统。该舰没有回应任何问候信息或数据传输。

建议小心为上。
texts.en:
A single, massive warship has been discovered patrolling the [dreadnought_system.GetName] system. No organic life signs can be detected on the vessel, but it is emitting a very strong power signature and appears to be bristling with weapon systems. It does not respond to hails or data transmission.

Caution is advised.

label.en: Look at the size of that thing!
If a player disables the dreadnought

texts.zh:
我们成功在[guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName]星系使这艘自动化无畏舰丧失了行动力。虽然我方炮火猛烈，但是这艘战舰的舰体却大部分完好无损。

我们派出的特遣队进入该舰后发现里面的外星种群船员早已身亡多年，他们在临终前启动了某种自动巡逻模式，而这艘战舰的自动巡逻模式竟然已经运行了780万年。

虽然会耗费甚多资源，一些工程师相信该舰可以修复并服役于我军。它一定会成为强大的旗舰。
texts.en:
We have managed to disable the automated dreadnought in the [guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName] system. Despite the punishment it took from our ships, the structural integrity of the warship's massive hull remains largely intact.

Our boarding parties found the mummified remains of the dreadnought's alien crew still manning their stations. Before expiring, they activated some kind of automated patrol mode which the limited shipboard AI has been locked in for the past 7.8 million years.

Although it would take an incredible amount of resources, some of our engineers believe that the dreadnought can be restored and put back into service with our fleet. It would certainly make for a powerful flagship.

label.zh: 让该舰悬挂着我们的旗帜征战星辰大海吧！
label.en: That ship will sail the stars again under our flag!

label.zh: 那样做太浪费资源了。把它拆除掉回收利用吧。
label.en: It would be a waste of resources. Salvage it for parts.

notes.zh: 审阅注：三个选项互斥：a 启用修复项目；b 拆解（1000合金+5000能量，工程研究加成）；c（需 can_harvest_parts）获得 tech_leviathan_techgenesis 研究选项。无论选哪项，之后都会开启庆典情境。
notes.en: Review note: the three options are alternatives: a enables the repair project; b salvages it (1000 alloys, 5000 energy, engineering research bonus); c (needs can_harvest_parts) grants the tech_leviathan_techgenesis research option. A celebration situation starts afterwards in every case (leviathans_events_2.txt:4336-4384).

texts.zh: 我们在[guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName]星系所击败的巨无霸无畏舰基本上完好无损。虽然需要庞大数量的资源来修复它，但是一旦修复成功我们的舰队就能如虎添翼。
texts.en: The hull of the massive dreadnought that we disabled in the [guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName] system is largely intact. Though it will require an enormous amount of resources, we should be able to repair the warship and press it into service with our own fleet.

texts.zh: 这是值得载入史册的一天！我们训练有素的维修组和工程组成功完成了[guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName]星系的那艘古代无畏舰的维修工程。现在这艘无畏舰已经满载着我们的机组人员开始试航了。
texts.en: This is a momentous day! Our skilled repair crews and engineers have finished their work on the ancient dreadnought we disabled in the [guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName] system. The massive warship has received its full crew complement and been declared ready for service after conducting space trials.

texts.zh: 今天是意义非凡的一天！我们娴熟的修理机器人和工程单位修好了我们在[guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName]恒星系击败的远古无畏舰。这艘巨型战舰的船员已经齐备，经过航空测试后开始准备服役。
texts.en: This is a day of significance! Our skilled repair bots and engineering units have finished their work on the ancient dreadnought we disabled in the [guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName] system. The massive warship has received its full crew complement and been declared ready for service after conducting space trials.

label.en: A powerful addition to our fleet.

note.zh: 生成一艘跳跃无畏舰（若有灵跃引擎则为灵跃无畏舰）。
note.en: Creates a Jump Dreadnought (a Psi Jump Dreadnought if the owner has the psi jump drive).

summary.text:
# 自动无畏战舰 / Automated Dreadnought

- 分类 Category：巨兽与城邦 · 来源 Sources: events/leviathans_events_2.txt:4221-4477; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:912, :1398 · DLC：利维坦 Leviathans · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts
首次进入守卫星系：3100“自动无畏战舰”（每帝国一次）。
First entry into the guarded system fires 3100.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline
玩家瘫痪无畏战舰（on_ship_destroyed_victim → 隐藏 3101）：3102“无畏战舰已被瘫痪”。
- a 启用项目 DISABLED_DREADNOUGHT_PROJECT → 3103 修复完成，生成一艘（灵跃）跳跃无畏舰。
- b 拆解：1000合金、5000能量与工程研究加成。
- c 收割部件（需能力）：tech_leviathan_techgenesis 研究选项。
之后开启庆典情境（见庆典故事）。

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes
三选一；只有 a 通向 3103。

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants
机器帝国使用不同描述文本；灵跃引擎决定舰型。

## 审阅记录 Review notes
合并 event-leviathans-3100 / -3101。完整。 Merged two stories; complete.
